description: Dev-cohort (Perez 2022) nested CV on pseudobulk features restricted to the 30,165-gene intersection with GSE135779 (same restriction used for the sealed-cohort pseudobulk scoring). Produced to test whether the dev-vs-sealed pseudobulk optimism gap is confounded by the 51% gene-space reduction (F2), post-hoc, after the sealed cohort was already opened -- logged per PREREGISTRATION_DEVIATIONS.md item 10. Does not touch, re-open, or re-score GSE135779.
permutation_status: NOT_YET_RUN -- compute-cost-prohibitive on verification hardware (single CPU core); must be run on Kaggle (matching the rest of this pipeline's expensive steps) before this arm's p-value can be reported. CI lower bound of 0.9729 makes chance-level performance implausible but is not a substitute for the permutation test.
cv_scheme: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5), not GroupKFold: identical reasoning and code path as scripts/15_l2_dev_cv_pseudobulk_metadata.py (each donor is already exactly one row).

gene_space_restriction_effect_paired_boo.interpretation: CI includes zero: the gene-space restriction's effect on dev-cohort AUROC is not statistically distinguishable from zero at 95% confidence. This supports treating the dev-restricted-vs-sealed-restricted gap as attributable to cohort shift rather than feature-space mismatch.

corrected_like_for_like_deltas.note: Recomputed directly from full-precision decimal values, not from rounded displayed figures.
